title: Publish only verified static artifacts
description:
As a site visitor, I want each production release to be a static artifact built and verified by GitHub Actions, so that the deployed site is current without AWS Amplify running analysis or CI.

Feature: GitHub-built static deployment

Scenario: A validated main commit is deployed
Given a committed leaderboard data file and a successful GitHub CI build for main
When the deployment job runs
Then it uploads the exact tested static artifact to manual Amplify Hosting
And Amplify does not install dependencies, run replay, or generate leaderboard data.

Scenario: A pull request is evaluated
Given a pull request
When GitHub CI runs
Then it runs source and site checks without replaying studies or generating leaderboard data
And it does not deploy to production.
